description: Pre-spend budget approval check. Verifies daily/weekly/category limits, estimates ROI from your own past spends with this service, and suggests cheaper alternatives you have used. Call this BEFORE paying for any service.

agent_id.description: Your agent's name. It belongs to the wallet you pay from: only calls paid from that wallet can read or change it (register it first)

amount_usd.description: Amount you're about to spend in USD

service_id.description: Service you want to pay for (e.g. 'harvey-tools/scrape_url')

name: check_spend
